{{Quote|Officials are said to be suspicious of the local slave trader's sect, the Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild, of trading slaves even though the Empire officially stated their trades 'illegal'.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
The '''Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild''' was a sect of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] that operated in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The Zel'iphian Slave Traders were active in the Dantooine system where they usually captured hapless starships. They then traded their victims to remote [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations or criminal warlords.<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> The guild was led by a council.<ref name="SWG:aN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|a Notification}}</ref>

They Zel'iphian slavers controlled the Dantooine system's [[Ith'ril Eventide (space area)|Area D-504]], which they later renamed after their leader [[Ith'ril Eventide]] after he took control of the organization.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> Pilots of the Guild were known as Vin Guardians and patrolled the area with ferocity, attacking any intruder on sight. Vin Guardians were also present in the dangerous [[Sserician Eclipse]] area.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66853&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Dantooine System}}</ref>

In space battles, the Zel'iphian Slave Traders flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:DS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Dantooine system}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|'Our sources are still investigating the issue', Officer Vghand of the Imperial Navy says. 'They won't be able to get away with it for too long.' The Zel'iphian Slave Traders still deny any claim to trading slaves.|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN" />}}
Although the Zel'iphian were notorious slavers, they denied any claim to trading slaves. However, as [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] was officially banned in the Empire, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] examined the operations of the Zel'iphian Traders. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial Officer]] [[Vghand]] investigated the Zel'iphian Guild and intended to prove that the organization was actively trading slaves.<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> Therefore, the slavers began to diversify their business to [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade.<ref name="SWG:aN" />

During the Galactic Civil War, the Empire was unable to protect civilian vessels from Zel'iphian pirates in the Dantooine system. Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]], made an alliance with local [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealers]], such as the [[O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild]], to protect themselves against the Zel'iphian Slave Traders.<ref name="SWGJtLPOGG" />

[[Antage Oran]] was a member of the guild.<ref name="SWG:aN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Zel'iphian Slave Traders were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />
